description: A small black hard case sits on the table in front, and inside are a gray item and a couple of small round containers. The left hand moves in to steady the case while the right hand unlatches and lifts the lid open, then the right hand reaches in and removes the gray right-hand object to the right side, reaches back in to pick up a small white piece, and sets it down on the table near the gray item while the left hand stays near the case without holding anything.
